title: Pixel Art
description: Pixel art builds the image from visible tiles or a low-resolution grid. The world is discrete squares, not continuous grain.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: The world is tiles. If the beat is actually Video Game, change the setup instead of forcing pixel art.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: For pixel art: a genre look is light, palette, lens, and blocking together, not the genre name alone. In a prompt it reads like this: Pixel-art treatment of the subject, chunky samples, limited palette, game-sprite cinema.
Write a start state, one change, and an end frame the next shot can inherit.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Pixel Art is easier to picture if you remember "Wreck-It Ralph adjacent", "indie games". Borrow camera, light, and subject relationships, not a copyrighted still.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Lead with who does what. Camera, light, and style follow.
Do not replace physics with mood adjectives. Still clause: Pixel-art treatment of the subject, chunky samples, limited palette, game-sprite cinema.
At most one motivated camera move per clip. The last frame is law for the next shot.
Pixel-art treatment of [Subject], chunky samples, limited palette, game-sprite cinema.
